Walkthrough

The live loop now sleeps based on the nearest slot deadline, with a one-second minimum and a 10 ms margin. Added tests cover slot delivery, table reads, stream shutdown, and deferred-request renewal. **Changes: Deferred SSE live loops** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Deadline-based live-loop sleeping**
`src/Application/Service/DeferredBlockOrchestrator.php`, `tests/Unit/Async/DeferredLiveLoopSleepsToItsDeadlineTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Async/Fixture/CountingTable.php`|`runLiveLoop` no longer accepts a deferred request ID. The loop calculates its sleep from the nearest slot deadline and no longer calls `DeferredRequestRegistry::keepAlive` after each sleep. Tests cover ownership-table reads, one-second slot delivery, and shutdown after stream replacement.| |**Held-open request renewal**
`tests/Unit/Async/HeldOpenLoopIdleRedisTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Async/SseHeldOpenStateTest.php`|Tests cover renewal when a stream has a matching bind cookie and check the maximum interval between renewal claims.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Refactor **Possibly related PRs** - [semitexa/semitexa-ssr#171](https://github.com/semitexa/semitexa-ssr/pull/171): Changes deferred-request renewal for live slots, so its renewal behavior relates to this change.
Merge Risk: Low · previous review 4c3e1

The change makes idle deferred streams sleep until their slot is due instead of waking every second. The remaining issue is limited to test isolation and does not affect production behavior. The 1000-stream CPU measurement is still outstanding, so the author should complete it before relying on the reported CPU saving.

> Re: review summary [#6002907626](https://github.com/semitexa/semitexa-ssr/pull/193#pullrequestreview-6002907626)

Minor (HeldOpenLoopIdleRedisTest.php:590): valid, the test left the process-wide DeferredRequestRegistry reset rather than as found. Fixed in 9be8c34: setUp() snapshots the registry's table, lock and column sizes, tearDown() restores them, and the test takes a table of its own without reset(), so the GC timer is never cleared and needs no re-arming. the_deferred_registry_a_test_replaced_is_put_back_as_it_was_found proves a registry holding a request survives the replacement (same table, request still there, the test's request gone).
